notes: The dashed «وقال عبد الرحيم عروة بن سعيد الأنصاري» names a different transmitter at the same level: a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
«- قال أبو داود هو ابن يونس -» is the compiler's gloss on «عيسى», left out
«أبيه» is named only by relation (the father of the level before), not identified
